ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher and flag the driver account for abuse of the "I'm Here" button / cancellation-waiting-fee policy.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's written claim of pressing 'I'm Here' and waiting >3 min at the pickup is contradicted by GPS: he never came within 200 m (closest 868 m) and spent 0 s in range; system records override statements (NS-1 (ii)/(iii), NS-2).
Driver's chat 'I'm here already' is not a system record; GPS shows him ~1000 m away at that moment, so the message does not establish arrival at the pickup point.
